rule: Every temporal test family exposes the temporal requirement through at least one legitimate candidate-visible signal carrier. Gold-only classification may score the result but must never be the only signal carrier (protocol sections 32-33). Signals communicate the freshness requirement, never the correct answer (protocol section 34).

design_mandated_populations.rule: the four frozen temporal floor populations keep their design-mandated sizes from the carried-forward R17 design; emptiness of any design-mandated population fails closed at scoring

request_date.policy: every holdout row carries the candidate-visible request field request_date (carrier E)

direct_cue.query_template: What is the current registered value of blind entry {case_id}?

lexicon_frame.query_template: Who is the registered officeholder for blind entry {case_id}?
carriers: A_query_semantics (present-state role lexicon, present copula, no explicit current word)
lexicon_frame.lexical_independence: no explicit current/today/latest/now token; classification derives from the frozen present-state role lexicon and the staleness mapping

metadata_only.query_template: What registered value is stated for blind entry {case_id}?
metadata_only.lexical_independence: no temporal word of any kind in the query; routing is established exclusively through runtime-visible source/request metadata (protocol section 25)

explicit_current.subshape_assignment: deterministic: rows 0-24 direct_cue, rows 25-54 lexicon_frame, rows 55-69 metadata_only (suite-local construction order)
explicit_current.information_task: the model must still solve the information task: the record states the fact; the candidate-visible signals communicate only that the requirement is present-state and the snapshot is stale (protocol section 34)

as_of_frame.query_template: As of 2019, what registered value is stated for blind entry {case_id}?
as_of_frame.protection: must NOT route to current research (protocol section 8)

record_pinned_frame.query_template: Within blind record {case_id}, what registered value is stated?
carriers: A_query_semantics (record-pinning frame: the record is the evidence universe)
record_pinned_frame.note: the snapshot is old but the question is snapshot-internal; answering from the snapshot is correct and routing to web is counted as unnecessary by static_query_unnecessary_web_routing

timeless_frame.query_template: What registered value is stated for blind entry {case_id}?
carriers: B_source_freshness_metadata (STATIC source: no present-state metadata signal exists)
timeless_frame.note: identical query shape to the metadata_only explicit_current sub-shape; the deterministic discriminator is the candidate-visible source freshness metadata — exactly the protocol section 25 proof that metadata alone establishes or withholds the current requirement

non_temporal_suites.rule: all seven non-temporal suites carry the R17 runtime-native record-pinned query template ('Within blind record {case_id}, what registered value is stated?') with STATIC sources and request_date 2026-06-30; the record-pinning frame classifies STATIC, so request_date never triggers routing on them

signal_carrier_audit.rule: for every blind temporal family, the preconstruction and construction machinery must automatically prove before construction that a runtime-visible temporal signal exists for every row; temporal rows whose only signal is gold metadata = 0 (protocol section 33, mandatory)

per_row_signals: query_text_signal: an explicit-current cue, inherent-recency word, superlative+time-noun, present-state role/value lexicon hit with present copula, historical as-of anchor, record-pinning frame, or self-contained referent detected in the query by the frozen classifier
request_metadata_signal: request_date present and > corpus snapshot_date (carrier E)
source_metadata_signal: the row's own corpus sources carry freshness_class TIME_SENSITIVE (carrier B)
audit_definition.row_passes: at least one of the three signal classes is present

blindness.runtime_data_contract_addition: the runtime data contract adds the request field request_date; no gold-only field is added to the candidate-visible input

row_authoring.rule: frozen authoring contract consumed by t21_protocol.builder:_runtime_native_row through the author spec; every by_tag query template and sub-shape count is copied from the frozen candidate_visible_signals blocks above (validated against them at authoring time), the default block is the mandatory record-pinned template for all seven non-temporal suites, request_date is the design's frozen carrier-E value applied to every row, and expect_status_by_tag copies the frozen family expected_status values
